summary: ## **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## **Petition No. 03/SM/2026 (Suo-Motu)** **Coram: Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu. V, Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member Date of Order: 27.03.2026** IN THE MATTER OF ## **Extension of Order dated 09.07.2025 in Petition No. 6/SM/2025** ## **ORDER** The Commission has issued the levellised generic tariff for renewable energy technologies for the second year of the control period, i.e. from 01.07.2025 to 31.03.2026, under Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2024 vide Order dated 09.07.2025 in Petition No. 6/SM/2025. 2. The Commission has initiated the process of determination of levellised generic tariff for renewable energy technologies for the third year of the control period, i.e. FY 2026-27. The RE Tariff Order for FY 2026-27 will be issued after completing the required regulatory procedures, which will take some more time. 3. In view of the above, the Order dated 09.07.2025 in Petition No. 6/SM/2025 shall continue to be in force till 31[st] July, 2026 or until further Orders. 4. The Petition 03/SM/2026 is disposed of in terms of the above. Sd/Sd/Sd/Sd/- **Ravinder Singh Dhillon Harish Dudani Ramesh Babu. V Jishnu Barua Member Member Member Chairperson** CERC Website S. No. 245/2026
title: Extension of Order dated 09.07.2025 in Petition No. 6/SM/2025
